title: Diagnostics & Privacy Settings and Commuter Data Protection
releaseNotes: Diagnostics & Privacy Settings: Dedicated section in App Settings to manage telemetry preferences, view local sync status, and clear diagnostic logs.
Cellular Data Saver: Configured crash diagnostics to transmit over Wi-Fi only by default to preserve commuter mobile data allowances.
Transparent Privacy Assurance: Prominent developer assurance guarantee ensuring zero user personal information or data is collected.
Onboarding Privacy Step: Added an optional stability reporting preference check during initial student setup.
